node.statement: PART III — EFFICIENT PURE STATE TOMOGRAPHY. Theorem 1.2: Algorithm A_GKKT using n = O((d + log(1/delta))/epsilon) copies of a pure state |psi> outputs |v> with |<v|psi>|^2 >= 1-epsilon with probability >= 1-delta, using unentangled measurements in poly(n) time. Also, Proposition 1.7: Hayashi algorithm achieves the same sample complexity.
